purpose: Translate the supplied frontier-data survey and its linked primary reports into testable Speck data-design implications.
evidence_boundary: The survey is a secondary synthesis supplied for review. Linked primary reports support the directional findings below, but their token counts, mixtures and ablations are not directly comparable to Speck and do not establish source rights or transfer.

high_confidence_findings.finding: The disclosed recipes change data composition and context length across training stages; a single static mixture percentage is an incomplete description.
high_confidence_findings.speck_implication: Represent source exposure as a schedule over pretraining, capability mid-training, context extension and post-training. Keep all stage tokens and repetition counts explicit.

high_confidence_findings.finding: Quality scores are used for sampling and upweighting, while some lower-scoring material is retained for coverage and long-tail knowledge.
high_confidence_findings.speck_implication: Prefer calibrated quality-weighted sampling with coverage strata over a single hard cutoff. Record score distributions, domain/language coverage and sampled exposure separately.

high_confidence_findings.finding: Math, code, PDFs and structured web pages require source-specific extraction; generic cleaning can remove the signal being optimized.
high_confidence_findings.speck_implication: Add extraction fidelity and notation preservation to math/code gates before quality ranking. A publisher score or successful parse is not correctness evidence.

high_confidence_findings.finding: Several recipes keep the broad core predominantly natural while introducing verified or targeted synthetic reasoning and agent data later.
high_confidence_findings.speck_implication: Keep natural-source identity separate from grounded transformations, synthetic reasoning, trajectories and reward prompts. Every transformation needs lineage, validation and a stage assignment.

high_confidence_findings.finding: Code capability data increasingly links repositories, files, issues, reviews, pull requests, commits, diffs and tests.
high_confidence_findings.speck_implication: Treat repository events as structured source families and measure context versus loss-bearing targets. Do not admit raw patches or co-present files without origin, license, family and behavioral checks.

high_confidence_findings.finding: Long-context gains are tied to distributed dependencies, related-document packing and recall tasks, not length alone.
high_confidence_findings.speck_implication: Add dependency-distance and position-stratified evaluation to context qualification. Count long documents separately from sequences whose targets require distant evidence.

high_confidence_findings.finding: Small proxy-model or smaller-scale ablations are used to choose quality weights, transformations and domain rates before expensive runs.
high_confidence_findings.speck_implication: Treat data recipe design as an experiment with controls, power or uncertainty estimates, fixed downstream evaluation and measured utility per token/GPU-hour.

high_confidence_findings.finding: Deduplication and benchmark decontamination are distinct, and public reports often disclose insufficient detail to reproduce benchmark removal.
high_confidence_findings.speck_implication: Keep benchmark-family joins and evaluation firewalls as independent admission gates. Never infer clearance from exact or semantic dedup alone.

adopt_now_as_design_requirements: Add stage, source family, transformation type, quality vector, dependency metadata and contamination status to candidate manifests.
Separate natural core, source-grounded transformation, synthetic reasoning, repository-event and agent-trajectory banks.
Use quality weighting with coverage constraints rather than a universal hard cutoff.
Measure token utility as held-out loss, capability gain, retention, preparation cost and allocated GPU-hours per exposed and unique token.
Add long-range dependency distance and position-stratified checks to the context packet.
Require independent correctness or outcome checks for rephrasing, learning notes, generated solutions, code repairs and trajectories.
defer_or_bound: Do not copy frontier mixture percentages; their model sizes, token definitions, repeated exposure and teacher pipelines differ.
Do not add a fourth pretraining arm. Transformations and stage schedules must fit the existing bounded study or replace a declared factor.
Do not introduce multimodal data into the first text-only release; retain native multimodal and rendered-code ideas for a later allocation.
Do not make broad AI-text removal a production rule until a source-aware detector has false-positive controls for math, code, OCR and long-tail knowledge.
Do not treat proxy-model rankings as final-model proof; confirm selected recipes at matched exposure with held-out families.

Do not adopt a sparse MoE backbone on this allocation. Rigel's 360M-active hybrid spent 5.4e21 non-embedding FLOPs, about 3.5T tokens by 6ND; Speck is bound by unique eligible supply near 100B tokens, and fewer active parameters raise the tokens needed per FLOP. Record fine-grained MoE on a linear-attention hybrid as the next program's architecture candidate.

recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.hypothesis: A mostly natural, quality-weighted mixture with specialized extraction and modest source-family repetition provides a stronger broad base than a hard high-score-only filter.
recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.measurement: Held-out source loss, domain/language coverage, utility per token and unique-supply retention.

recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.hypothesis: Grounded code/math transformations and repository-event sequences improve capability and downstream optimization efficiency when they preserve lineage and correctness.
recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.measurement: Capability per continuation token/GPU-hour, SFT convergence, early RL adaptation and source-family transfer.

recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.hypothesis: Sequences with explicit distant dependencies outperform equally long but locally predictable documents for useful-context behavior.
recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.measurement: Position-stratified retrieval, multi-file reasoning, dependency-distance loss and short-task retention.

recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.hypothesis: Verified outcome data and on-policy/agent trajectories should be selected by task validity and reward reliability, not by length or reasoning verbosity.
recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.measurement: Independent task outcomes, supervised-token efficiency, reward agreement, failure recovery and held-out transfer.

recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.hypothesis: A late phase that shifts exposure toward higher-quality web, math and code (Rigel reports 35% math and 35% code in its fourth of six phases) improves capability per token over ordinary decay at the same unique supply. Rigel's late quality phases rest on Nemotron-CC-v2 and FinePDFs, neither decided for Speck, so its recipe does not show what the selected sources alone achieve.
recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.measurement: The existing decay study: paired-seed late-enrichment and ordinary-decay arms from one stable parent, compared on held-out source loss, development capability and unique-supply retention.

recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.hypothesis: Long chain-of-thought QA is useful context-extension data: Rigel's final phase extends 4,096 to 294,912 tokens over about 118B tokens in which long-CoT reasoning QA displaces nearly everything else.
recipe_hypotheses_for_the_existing_plan.measurement: Against dependency-aware long documents at matched exposure from one parent: retrieval across positions, cross-document reasoning, short-task retention and development reasoning scores.

admission_boundary: This synthesis updates hypotheses and experiment design only. It does not admit any external source, establish source rights, change the working mixture percentages, authorize acquisition or alter the 5,000-GPU-hour allocation.
